caption: The drawing features a still life arrangement of several objects on a neutral beige background. In the center is a small, cylindrical, metallic container with a dotted top, rendered in shades of gray to suggest its reflective surface. Behind the container are two tan-colored envelopes, one partially overlapping the other. Both envelopes have handwritten text; the visible one is addressed to "Henry Pardee, Ontario Co., New York" and dated "Saratoga Springs, Aug 17th 1822," with “18½” written in the upper right corner. In front of the metallic container, there is a white and light brown feather quill with a pointed tip. To the left of the quill, there is a wooden and metal seal stamp, depicted in brown and gold tones, with an orange-red wax seal positioned nearby on the surface. The artist's name, "Jessie M Youngs," is inscribed in small letters in the lower left corner. All objects are illustrated with careful attention to color, shading, and proportion, positioned against a plain, lightly textured background.
title: Sand Shaker
